title: Concept: Predictable randomness via random.randint (python) — review required
description: In python, random.randint is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only secrets.token_bytes / secrets.choice provides in python.
applicability: python codebases drawing random values through random.randint; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
